title: Free Museums in London for Kids: A Family Guide
description: The best free museums in London for kids: the Natural History Museum, Science Museum, Young V&A and British Museum, with booking tips.
h1: Free museums in London for kids
intro: London has some of the best museums on the planet, and many of them are free. Here are the family favourites and how to make the most of a free day out in the capital.

keywords: free things to do in london with kids
cardText: Dinosaurs, rockets and toys: London’s best free museums for families.

blocks.title: Scout’s London plan
blocks.text: South Kensington is museum heaven: the Natural History Museum, Science Museum and V&A sit side by side. Pick one or two, not all three, with little ones.
points: Book free timed tickets at busy times
Arrive at opening for the dinosaurs
Special exhibitions and some activities charge

sections.html: Dinosaurs, a blue whale skeleton in Hintze Hall, and an earthquake simulator. General admission is free. nhm.ac.uk
Space, flight and hands-on galleries. General admission is free. Some interactive galleries and special exhibitions charge. sciencemuseum.org.uk
In Bethnal Green, east London, the Young V&A is a free museum designed for children and young people, packed with play and design. vam.ac.uk/young
Egyptian mummies, the Rosetta Stone and treasures from around the world. General admission is free. britishmuseum.org
Travel in by train and use the 2FOR1 offers for a paid attraction, grab a free photo at Platform 9¾ at King’s Cross, and picnic in a royal park. Visiting from abroad? See London city breaks.

faqs.q: Is the Natural History Museum free?
faqs.a: Yes. General admission is free. Some special exhibitions charge, and you may want to book a free timed ticket at busy times.

faqs.q: What is the best free museum in London for toddlers?
faqs.a: The Young V&A in Bethnal Green is designed for children, and the Natural History Museum’s dinosaurs are a hit with all ages.
